mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rates above 7.5% triggers a loss of investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE crossing above 7.5%, or the crossing is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in consumer demand (GDPC1) and falling federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) creates a favorable macro environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > previous value AND FEDFUNDS < previous value
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive when both conditions occur, or the combination does not lead to higher returns than baseline.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, sustained growth in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust supply-side activity, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not positive in late-cycle expansions when INDPRO rises >5%, or the rise is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden inflation spike (CPIAUCSL crossing above 2.0) raises policy uncertainty, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite CPIAUCSL crossing above 2.0, or the crossing is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: Rising labor participation (PAYEMS) coupled with falling unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a strengthening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > previous value AND UNRATE < previous value
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive when both labor indicators move in tandem, or the combination does not outperform baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing-related demand (HOUST) reflects broader economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not positive when HOUST is rising, or the trend reverses.

mechanism_narrative: In a recovery regime, sustained growth in personal consumption (GDPC1) signals renewed economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not positive in recovery regimes when GDPC1 rises >5%, or the rise is not sustained.
